windows.command: py -3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate.bat && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt

osx.command: python3.12 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt

linux.command: python3.12 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
